algorithm: MeshLink/1 end-to-end first message (Noise IK and IKhfs message 1)

notes.ReferenceKeys: Keys, ephemerals, the KEM seed and the seal randomness come from fixed labels in tools/reference. The initiator is alice, the responder bob; responder_key is the static key the initiator holds for the responder (pre-message).
notes.Replay: The initiator writes message 1 from its inputs, responder_key and payload; its output equals message except for Tampered tests. For IK the payload is plaintext; for IKhfs it is the HPKE seal of plaintext with info and encapsulation_randomness (as hpke-seal.json), except for TamperedSeal tests. The responder reads message to payload, then for IKhfs opens payload to plaintext with xwing_secret_key. handshake-failed: the Noise read fails; open-failed: the read succeeds and the seal does not open.
notes.Tampered: One bit of message 1 flipped in transit.
notes.TamperedSeal: One bit of the HPKE seal flipped before the initiator writes it.
notes.WrongResponderKey: The initiator holds another node's static key for the responder.
